data.body: [P2] Ensure the deadlock regression terminates after failure. When this test catches the oversized-overflow regression, the 30-second timeout ends `runner.run()`, but runner cleanup does not release the separate `dex-handler` executor blocked on the checkpoint. Python joins those workers at interpreter shutdown, so pytest hangs until the CI job timeout, as the PR description also reports. Run this scenario in a child process with a hard timeout and terminate/join that process on failure, so detecting the regression produces a bounded test failure.
